title: Suzuki Roshi's Life and Teachings, Creating a New Temple
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett begins a study of Shunryu Suzuki Roshi's Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind, setting the Lotus Sutra aside for now as the sangha raises money for a new temple in Bellingham in Suzuki Roshi's lineage. Nomon reads a draft of the fundraising cover letter, then Huston Smith's preface, which includes Suzuki Roshi's reply when asked why satori never appears in the book. Richard Baker's funeral words follow, along with cautions about putting the great man on a pedestal and about Baker's claim that Suzuki Roshi came to a land without Buddhism. A short video of Bill Kwong closes the evening, recalling the glass of wine Suzuki Roshi suggested to loosen him up before dokusan.
